prompt: How many 20th-century paintings have been sold for at least $100 million (in nominal sale price) at Christie’s New York since 2020?
answer: 3 — Pablo Picasso’s *Femme assise près d’une fenêtre (Marie-Thérèse)* ($103.41 million, 2021), Andy Warhol’s *Shot Sage Blue Marilyn* ($195 million, 2022), and René Magritte’s *L’empire des lumières* ($121.2 million, 2024).
